section.note: I care about the whole path: the data model, the API, the interface, and the last ten percent of polish.

intro: I graduated in Computer Science from IIIT Sri City in 2025. Since then I've shipped a delivery app, a B2B project platform, an AI voice assistant, and a few things in between.

My favourite part of the job is the translation step — turning a fuzzy request into a working screen, a clean endpoint, or a model call that behaves. I'd rather ship something small that holds up than something big that only demos well.
